title: Fix stale lore:tasks block and stale prose in harden-and-qualify-quest-cli-0-2-x Story
description: docs/stories/harden-and-qualify-quest-cli-0-2-x.md has a stale <!-- lore:tasks --> managed block: QCLI-97 renders Done in reality but the block/prose treat related work as still open. lore check currently exits 1 with [managed-block-drift]. finalSummary: Fixed both parts. (1) lore check exited 1 with managed-block-drift: the <!-- lore:tasks --> block pointed QCLI-97 at its old .quest/tasks/ location after it was archived to .quest/archive/tasks/. lore sync regenerated the block (and docs/log.md); the row content (QCLI-97 To Do) was already accurate, only the path was stale. (2) The surrounding 'What the Story does not yet close' prose claimed QCLI-97.5 retained three open criteria and QCLI-97.11 was unfinished; both have since closed -- QCLI-97.5 (QCLI-207) with all three criteria checked, QCLI-97.11 (QCLI-196) closed this same wave as a stale migration-parent superseded by its five completed children. Rewrote the paragraph to state this, leaving QCLI-97's own To Do status untouched since it was out of scope here. Verified: lore check now exits 0 (63 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings; was 1 error).
